about: The sufficient resolution is the coarsest at which the verdict already equals the finest one; it is strictly coarser than the finest where the verdict saturates.

cases.name: a verdict that saturates at three steps
falsifier: a verdict that changes at every resolution

coverage.criterion: a verdict that saturates below the finest resolution, and a falsifier that changes at every one
coverage.why: two verdicts; saturation is read at eight steps only
